title: Usage-capped observability add-ons and contract prototype for enterprise security onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
This ticket scopes a compact, usage-capped observability add-on (retention + query credits) paired with a light-touch contract prototype and security questionnaire flow to accelerate enterprise onboarding. Goal is to enable sales/legal to offer a short-term, bounded observability bundle during early Dedicated/Private trials without exposing unlimited data retention or long-term SLA commitments.

Background:
Enterprise prospects frequently request longer retention and a premium SLA during procurement but legal and SRE teams are reluctant to commit without usage caps and clear entitlements. Existing add-on experiments focus on tiered retention or pure retention upsells; this prototype combines a per-tenant retention window cap (e.g., 30d) + query credit pool + a templated contract clause that defines rollback and overage handling. We will test whether this reduces negotiation cycles and time-to-PoC while keeping operational risk low.

Proposed deliverables:
- Product config for a "Usage-Capped Observability" add-on (UI + API flags) that sets retention window, query-credit bucket, and soft-overage alerts.
- Contract prototype language (one-page amendment) that defines entitlements, overage pricing, and termination/rollback triggers.
- Security questionnaire checklist (subset of the full enterprise SQ) required for the add-on enablement path.
- Pilot plan with 3 sales accounts and a 6-week measurement window (SLA requests, negotiation time, infra incidents, cost deltas).

Success metrics:
- 30% reduction in average deal negotiation time for pilot accounts that opt into the addon.
- Zero unplanned SLA degradation incidents attributable to pilot resources.
- >50% of pilot accounts convert to paid addon or request extension after trial.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Customers exceed capped query credits causing friction. Mitigation: soft throttling + email + Console overage simulation prior to activation.
- Risk: Legal pushes for broader guarantees. Mitigation: limit pilot to pre-approved accounts and require an executive signoff flow for any SLA escalations.
acceptance_criteria: Console: new addon config UI that allows selecting retention window (7/30/90 days) and query-credit bucket with visible SKU pricing
API: toggle via account API to enable usage-capped observability with JSON response showing limits and current usage
Contract: one-page amendment PDF uploaded to Drive and linked in the onboarding checklist; must include overage rates and rollback language
Security questionnaire: templated 12-question subset in Confluence and a short form embedded in the onboarding flow
Pilot: at least 3 enterprise accounts onboarded, with measurement dashboard capturing negotiation time and infra metrics
Runbook: SRE mitigation playbook for overage and retention rollback tested in staging
tasks: PM: finalize addon SKU matrix and pricing bands
Design: mockups for addon selection and status in Console account settings
Engineering: implement account-level retention and query-credit enforcement (backend + API)
Legal: draft one-page amendment and approve rollback clause
Security: curate 12-question SQ subset and approve the minimal checklist
Solutions Eng: select pilot accounts and coordinate activation
Analytics: build pilot dashboard and baseline negotiation-time metric
